title: MZ Class Change System VisuStella MZ HELP

posts.author: Benku
posts.body: OK, so I'm making a mech game for RPG Maker. It uses 'class' as the base for the mechs. Some transform and revert back after battle. For some reason, it unlocks them in the class window. I don't want them to show up as unlocked since their transform state is there. Can anyone help me with this or give me some insight?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: The plugin settings has 'Always unlocked classes' Did you check those?

posts.author: Benku
posts.body: Yes, I did, and they are all zero, just as intended.
